video.description: The piglet is SPROCKET: brown tool belt with a gold buckle and two brown pouches, silver wrench in one hoof, no goggles. The tractor is blue and in good condition.

beats.action: Sprocket faces the camera and points back at the blue tractor with an excited "ooh" face.
He turns to the camera, raises one hoof like a teacher saying "wait", then heads over to the tractor.
He leans in close to the tractor's engine and carefully inspects the bolts, quiet and patient.
He spots something, points at one bolt, and turns his head to the camera with a delighted face.
He fits his wrench on the bolt and gives it two firm turns; the tractor shudders and rumbles and a puff of grey smoke pops from the exhaust stack.
